name: Text to Speech
summary: Reads a script out loud in 23 languages with Resemble AI's Chatterbox, on open weights: a clean voice, no API and no account.

source.notes: One node (Chatterbox Multilingual TTS, 23 languages) into SaveAudio. The node downloads its weights into ComfyUI/models/tts/chatterbox/ on the first run (safetensors + tokenizer, a few GB) and runs on ROCm like the rest of the stack; the only package it adds is s3tokenizer.

inputs.label: Text
inputs.default: Bonjour, ici RiverField. Ceci est une courte phrase lue par Chatterbox pour vérifier la voix.
inputs.help: Punctuation is respected: commas and full stops set the pacing.

inputs.label: Expressiveness
inputs.help: 0 reads flat and calm, 1 pushes the emotion; 0.5 is the model's default.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: 0 lets the model pick a random seed.

notes: The weights are not in a pack: the node downloads them itself into ComfyUI/models/tts/chatterbox/ the first time it runs (a few GB), then keeps them. 23 languages share one multilingual model, so a single voice reads a French line and an English one. For a voice of your own, the Text to Speech (clone) app takes a reference clip instead of the built-in voice. Chatterbox adds a Resemble watermark unless it is turned off; it is off here.
